entries.title: II Timothy 2:1
segments: Do you, then, my Child, find strength in the help which comes from the union with Christ Jesus;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:2
segments: and what you learnt from me, in the presence of many listeners, entrust to reliable men, who will be able in their turn to teach others.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:3
segments: Share hardships with me, as a true soldier of Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:4
segments: A soldier on active service, to please his superior officer, always avoids entangling himself in the affairs of ordinary life.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:5
segments: No athlete is ever awarded the wreath of victory unless he has kept the rules.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:6
segments: The labourer who does the work should be the first to receive a share of the fruits of the earth.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:7
segments: Reflect upon what I say; the Lord will always help you to understand.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:8
segments: Keep before your mind Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, a descendant of David, as told in the Good News entrusted to me;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:9
segments: in the service of which I am suffering hardships, even to being put in fetters as a criminal. But the Message of God is not fettered;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:10
segments: and that is why I submit to anything for the sake of God's People, that they also may obtain the Salvation which comes from union with Christ Jesus, and imperishable glory.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:11
segments: How true this saying is-- 'If we have shared his death, we shall also share his life.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:12
segments: If we continue to endure, we shall also share his throne. If we should ever disown him, he, too, will disown us.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:13
segments: If we lose our trust, he is still to be trusted, for he cannot be false to himself!'

entries.title: II Timothy 2:14
segments: Remind people of all this; urge them solemnly, as in the sight of God, to avoid controversy, a useless thing and the ruin of those who listen to it.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:15
segments: Do your utmost to show yourself true to God, a workman with no reason to be ashamed, accurate in delivering the Message of the Truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:16
segments: Avoid profane prattle. Those who indulge in it only get deeper into irreligious ways,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:17
segments: and their teaching will spread like a cancer. Hymenaeus and Philetus are instances of this.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:18
segments: They have gone completely astray as regards the Truth; they say that a resurrection has already taken place, and so upset some people's faith.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:19
segments: Yet God's firm foundation still stands unmoved, and it bears this inscription-- 'THE LORD KNOWS THOSE WHO ARE HIS'; and this-- 'LET ALL THOSE WHO USE THE NAME OF THE LORD TURN AWAY FROM WICKEDNESS.'

entries.title: II Timothy 2:20
segments: Now in a large house there are not only things of gold and silver, but also others of wood and earthenware, some for better and some for common use.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:21
segments: If, then, a man has escaped from the pollution of such errors as I have mentioned, he will be like a thing kept for better use, set apart, serviceable to its owner, ready for any good purpose.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:22
segments: Flee from the passions of youth, but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, in the company of those who, with a pure heart, invoke the Lord.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:23
segments: Shun foolish and ignorant discussions, for you know that they only breed quarrels;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:24
segments: and a Servant of the Lord should never quarrel. He ought, on the contrary, to be courteous to every one, a skillful teacher, and forbearing.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:25
segments: He should instruct his opponents in a gentle spirit; for, possibly, God may give them a repentance that will lead to a fuller knowledge of Truth,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:26
segments: and they may yet come to a sober mind, and escape from the snares of the Devil, when captured by the Lord's Servant to do the will of God.
